articles.title: Trump says war on Iran could be 'ending fairly soon', but warned that US is 'locked and loaded'
articles.summary:
Trump says war on Iran could be 'ending fairly soon', but warned that US is 'locked and loaded'

US President Donald Trump suggested that the war on Iran could end "fairly soon", but warned that the US is militarily "locked and loaded".

"We’re seeing momentum toward the end of this conflict. I think it’s going to be ending fairly soon," he said during a news conference. 

Trump expressed that Tehran was "talking very politely", but reiterated that its forces are ready to strike. 

"I don’t guarantee anything. But if we do have to go back in, we are locked and loaded and ready to go," the US president said.

articles.title: Russian military aircraft makes ‘unusual’ landing at Israel’s Ben Gurion Airport: Report
articles.summary: A Russian military aircraft used to transport senior officials and military personnel landed at Israel’s Ben Gurion Airport on Sunday evening in an “unusual” flight, Israeli public broadcaster KAN reported on Monday. The Tupolev Tu-154 aircraft arrived at the airport under circumstances that remain unclear, with no information available about the identities of its passengers or the purpose of the visit, according to KAN. The broadcaster said no similar landing had been recorded at the airport in recent years. The aircraft departed from Russia’s Chkalovsky Air Base near Moscow and landed at Ben Gurion Airport around 9 pm local time (1900GMT) Sunday, KAN reported. articles.title: Iraqi prime minister made unannounced visit to Tehran for talks on ending Iran-US war: Report
articles.summary: Iraqi Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi made an unannounced visit to Tehran on Friday for talks with Iran’s chief negotiator on efforts to end the war between Tehran and Washington, Iranian media reported Monday. Iran’s Fars news agency, citing an informed source, said al-Zaidi and his accompanying delegation met Mohammad Bagher Qalibaf, head of Iran’s negotiating team, during a visit lasting several hours. The source said the discussions focused exclusively on Iraq’s diplomatic efforts to end the Iran-US war, with no other issues addressed. Qalibaf expressed appreciation for Baghdad’s efforts and outlined Tehran’s two-day proposal, stressing that Washington must respect Iran’s rights under the plan to advance negotiations, according to the report.
